title: Finance & Business Management Data Scientist, Senior Associate

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Finance & Business Management Data Scientist, Senior Associate to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Play a lead role in data analytics and insight generation initiatives through your applied data science expertise.
Manage a comprehensive analytics strategy, from data acquisition to delivery
Leverage business acumen plus a variety of technical skills to design, develop and deliver valuable data products
Construct models/data applications tuned to yield salient, actionable insights
Design compelling visualizations that simplify complex analytics messaging for all stakeholders
Engage with business and functional stakeholders on analytics initiatives, developing strong partnerships grounded on data-driven solution
Distill substantial business needs into potential data solutions
Present data-driven insights, business value propositions, and standout next steps to senior stakeholders
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MSc. Or higher degree in a scientific field (Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, etc.) plus 3 years or more of experience in producing advanced analytics work with an emphasis in optimization
Strong proficiency in statistical software packages and data tools, including Python and SQL
Strong proficiency in Advanced Statistical methods and concepts, predictive modeling, time series forecasting, text mining
Strong storytelling capabilities including communicating complex concepts into digestible information for audiences of varying levels in the organization
Team player with a demonstrated strong work ethic, high level of professionalism, and ability to work well with cross-functional teams
Preferred Requirements
Fundamental data engineering experience in designing and building experimental data pipelines for data acquisition and delivery
Strong proficiency in Data Mining & Visualization (Tableau experience a plus)
Familiarity with MDLC best practices, with strong commitment to iterative development, ability to engage and update stakeholders as necessary, ensuring alignment, feedback incorporation, and transparency throughout the project lifecycle

You will take direction from senior leaders and set the analytical agenda at the intersection of data, technology, and finance.
We are looking for a data scientist with a track record of building analytics capabilities, strong quantitative problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate complex data findings into clear, actionable concepts for a range of stakeholders.
cond_0116.responsibilities:
Lead data analytics and insight generation initiatives through applied data science expertise.
Direct a comprehensive analytics strategy, from data acquisition to delivery
Apply business acumen and technical skills to design, develop, and deliver data products that generate real value
Build models and data applications that produce clear, actionable insights
Design compelling visualizations that make complex analytics accessible to all stakeholders
Drive engagement with business and functional stakeholders on analytics initiatives, building strong partnerships grounded in data-driven solutions
Translate substantial business needs into concrete data solutions
Present data-driven insights, business value propositions, and recommended next steps to senior stakeholders
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MSc or higher degree in a scientific field (Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, etc.) plus 3+ years of experience producing advanced analytics work with an emphasis in optimization
Strong proficiency in statistical software packages and data tools, including Python and SQL
Strong proficiency in advanced statistical methods and concepts, predictive modeling, time series forecasting, and text mining
Fundamental data engineering experience designing and building experimental data pipelines for data acquisition and delivery
Strong storytelling capabilities, including communicating complex concepts into digestible information for audiences at varying levels of the organization
Preferred Requirements
Strong proficiency in data mining and visualization (Tableau experience a plus)
Familiarity with MDLC best practices, with commitment to iterative development, stakeholder engagement, feedback incorporation, and transparency throughout the project lifecycle
Team player with a strong work ethic, high level of professionalism, and ability to work productively with cross-functional teams
